# SIX33 Fuel Systems

> Pre-launch site for SIX33 Fuel Systems: four premium powdered fuel systems with scripture on every packet, launching on Kickstarter. A movement by Seek First World, founded by Daniel Ziedins, named for Matthew 6:33 ("Seek first the Kingdom of God"). Nothing is on sale yet; the site collects a Kickstarter waitlist.

## The four systems
- Ignite — energy and focus (Romans 12:11)
- Flow — productivity and deep work (Colossians 3:23)
- Recover — recovery and electrolytes (Psalm 23:3)
- Rest — sleep and nervous-system support (Psalm 4:8)

## Key facts
- Status: coming soon; launch date not yet announced. Pricing is revealed on launch day.
- Kickstarter backer tiers: Scout (one system), Operator (full four-system box), Vanguard (founding circle).
- Full ingredient panels will be published before the campaign goes live.
- Parent brand: Seek First World (https://www.seekfirst.world). Part of the Thy Kingdom Network.
- Contact and wholesale/ministry partnerships: hello@thykingdom.net

## Journal
- [Seek First: What Matthew 6:33 Means on an Ordinary Tuesday](https://www.six33fuel.com/journal/seek-first-matthew-6-33-ordinary-tuesday): Matthew 6:33 is the verse SIX33 is named after. Here's what “seek first” looks like when the day is ordinary, the inbox is full and nobody is watching.
- [Why We Put Scripture on Every Packet](https://www.six33fuel.com/journal/why-we-put-scripture-on-every-packet): Each SIX33 system carries its own verse. Here's why — and what Romans 12:11, Colossians 3:23, Psalm 23:3 and Psalm 4:8 have to do with energy, focus, recovery and rest.
- [A Day on Mission: The Rhythm Behind the Four Systems](https://www.six33fuel.com/journal/a-day-on-mission-rhythm-behind-the-four-systems): 05:00 rise. 09:00 deep work. 17:00 after effort. 21:00 wind down. The daily rhythm behind SIX33's four systems — and the spiritual practices that belong at each point.
- [Rest Is Not Weakness: Psalm 4:8 and the Discipline of Stopping](https://www.six33fuel.com/journal/rest-is-not-weakness-psalm-4-8): Driven people treat rest as a reward for finishing. Scripture treats it as an act of trust. Why SIX33 built a whole system around stopping — and why Psalm 4:8 is on the packet.
- [Why SIX33 Is Launching on Kickstarter](https://www.six33fuel.com/journal/why-six33-is-launching-on-kickstarter): Why SIX33 Fuel Systems is launching through Kickstarter instead of a store, what founding backers get, and what we'll publish before the campaign goes live.
